title: Selling a car with an open recall
text: Yes, we buy cars with open safety recalls, and an open recall doesn't change your offer. Recall repairs are free at a dealer for your car's brand, so you can have it fixed first if you like, but you don't have to.

title: Broken or replaced odometer
text: If your odometer is broken, was replaced, or shows the wrong mileage, tell us when you request an offer. At the appointment, mark 'not actual mileage' on the odometer statement, form NW-ODO-1. Cars with 'not actual mileage' get a reduced offer. If you know the true mileage, bring records that show it, such as service invoices.

title: Selling a car that doesn't run
text: We don't buy cars that don't run or can't be driven safely to a store. If your car won't start, a local salvage buyer may be a better option.

title: Selling a car that doesn't run
text: We now buy cars that don't run. Select stores tow your car to the store at no charge; your offer page shows which stores near you offer towing. Cars that don't run can't use [home pickup](kb:home_pickup). The specialist confirms the offer after inspecting the car at the store. We still don't accept flood-damaged cars ([Flood-damaged cars](kb:flood_damage)).

title: Cars with aftermarket modifications
text: Aftermarket modifications rarely add value. Lift kits, engine tuning, loud exhausts and custom paint usually lower the offer, because we may need to return the car to factory condition. Remove anything you want to keep, such as a custom stereo, before the appraisal. If a modification changes the offer, the specialist shows you why ([What can change your offer](kb:what_changes_offer)).

title: Flood-damaged cars
text: Cars with flood damage, or with a flood brand on the title, count as branded, and we don't buy them ([Salvage and rebuilt titles](kb:branded_title)). If water ever got into the cabin or the engine, tell us when you request an offer.
